T20_prefix_cache_redo.note: Rows [arm, median prefill ms, median TTFT ms, median total ms]. Genuine exact-prefix KV cache (VIBEQUEUE-114): hits load stored document-prefix K/V tensors and prefill only the query tail (instrumented: only query tokens forwarded on hits, G2); first miss is byte-identical to monolithic (G1). 20 dev requests (5x500-token docs, fixed doc order) x 3 repeats, greedy 16, bf16 eager, untrained restart checkpoint (V66 pin). Prefix keys are ORDERED document tuples, so per-request shuffles miss every time while the DDI canonical cache (order-independent content keys) keeps its win (G5). Hit outputs match monolithic on 90% of requests (bf16 reduction-order divergence across shapes; preregistered as measured-not-gated) - DDI's canonical exact identity remains the contrast.
